meta_description:
9,683 likes, 167 comments - beebomco on October 7, 2026: "BAD NEWS For Airtel Users!

Airtel is increasing the prices of its postpaid plans starting tomorrow. The ₹449 postpaid plan will now cost ₹499, and the ₹699 plan will go up to ₹749.

This is a flat ₹50 price hike across all postpaid plans. The prices are also subject to 18% GST, so after tax the increase works out to ₹59 per month.

Alongside the price hike, Airtel is adding one new benefit for postpaid users. Every year, you can claim one free international roaming trip for up to 5 days.

So is it good or bad? 😐".
